text: Their unilateral work, which is what they do in their sport, can be more like 80% or 90% unilateral work in the gym because I don't want them to lose their rotational forces and skills. Anything that has to do with field athletes in sports that have a lot of change of direction and movement capacities in unilateral work, then they should have more. It should be a range anywhere from one side, like 90/10, to the other side, 10/90. We got to figure that out and put that algorithm together. Also, keeping in mind that sometimes the athletes might have some type of pain or some type of injury, for example, we need to adjust accordingly. Yeah. Again, the unilateral work is more for health and keeping rotational foundations, and the bilateral is more for driving and creating forces.
